note: Price data now comes from sostcore.com's own market-history gateway instead of each browser calling CoinGecko directly, so one upstream fetch is shared by every visitor (measured: 20 simultaneous visitors on the same timeframe = 100 client requests, 5 upstream; a 5-visitor sweep of all 11 timeframes = 275 client requests, 35 upstream, 87% hit rate). The gateway is closed - it accepts only an (asset, vs, range) triple from a fixed allowlist and builds the upstream URL from constants - with per-range TTLs, in-flight dedup, capped upstream concurrency, and stale-if-error so a chart shows slightly old data rather than nothing. The client keeps its own dedup, typed outcomes and 4-state per-series machine, and has no direct fallback to the upstream API on purpose. Also fixes a pre-existing bug: the original XAUT/BTC and PAXG/BTC charts fetched once at load with no retry and refresh() never re-fetched the BTC pairs, so a rate limit at page load left them blank until reload.
